where_youd_see_it: You would see this sign near railway tracks, especially at a level crossing or in areas where trains operate.
cultural_note: The primary sign above, featuring an exclamation mark within a red triangle, is a general danger sign (Gefahrenzeichen) in Germany. The text 'Bahnbetrieb' acts as a supplementary sign (Zusatzzeichen), specifying the nature of the danger or warning, in this case, related to railway activity.
